title: Why isn't the industry freaking out about DeepSeek 4.1 Flash?
summary: A Hacker News discussion reacting to a blog post questioning why the AI industry isn't more alarmed by DeepSeek 4.1 Flash. With nearly 900 points and 800+ comments, the thread debates the model's capabilities, competitive implications, and whether the muted response reflects genuine technical limitations or industry complacency.
